_about: KAISER 2 CARBON (BMW M2 G87 with a carbon body kit): its cabin is the M2's (data/dash/m2_g87.json), 4 cm higher in this model: the curved display (the cluster on the left, the iDrive screen on the right) is modelled with the interior's material and no UVs of its own, so its faces get a panel, the cluster on its left part, the iDrive pages on its right. Box: metres from the steering wheel's centre (the model's axes: x right, y up, z back).
